_guide.how: Edit, then run `npm run banners` (or `npm run banners -- name.jpg`) and reload the site. Each run prints the zoom and position it actually used.
_guide.framing: How every banner is framed, in % of the banner. The face is what's positioned: the runner's body follows.
_guide.framing.faceSize: The smallest the face may be, in % of the banner's height: stops a big photo zooming out too far. Most photos can't go that wide and are framed as wide as they allow.
_guide.framing.faceFromTop: Gap above the top of the face, in % of the banner's height. Bigger = runner lower.
_guide.framing.faceFromLeft: Where the centre of the face sits, in % of the banner's width from the left.
_guide.framing.maxFaceFromLeft: How far right the runner may be moved when a photo doesn't reach far enough right to fill the banner.
_guide.fade: The fade to white behind the title: startBeforeStripes and endAfterNavyStrip are px on a 1140px-wide banner; stops are [position %, white %] along it.
_guide.images: Adjustments for one photo, under its source filename. All optional; anything left out uses the framing above.
_guide.images.crop: Set by the visual editor (`npm run banners:edit`): the area of the photo the banner shows, { x, y, width } in source pixels. Wins over zoom, moves and face. Remove it (or use the editor's "Use automatic framing") to go back to automatic framing.
_guide.images.zoom: 1 = as wide as this photo allows (the default). 1.3 = 30% closer, 2 = twice as close. Below 1 isn't possible.
_guide.images.moveRight: Move the runner right by this % of the banner's width (negative = left). The photo's edges can stop it short; the run says so.
_guide.images.moveDown: Move the runner down by this % of the banner's height (negative = up). Same limit.
_guide.images.cropLeft: Cut this % off the left of the source photo (e.g. to remove someone at the edge). cropRight: the same on the right.
_guide.images.face: When the wrong person was picked: the right face's box, in pixels of the source photo { x, y, width, height }. slant-banners.detected.json lists other faces it found (otherFaces).
_guide.images.skip: true = no banner from this photo.
_guide.images.kind: "runner-left" to make a banner from a photo the script took for a group shot or a runner on the right.
